steps.coach_text: Swap to make a match of three or more. Some swaps produce specials.
Sometimes you can swap two specials close enough together that they will fuse and form a Mega gem.
Let's match three more tiles so we can be positioned to activate the Mega gem.
Specials can be activated by being adjacent to a match, or part of a match if they share the same base color.
Now try triggering these two specials in a chain by swapping the highlighted gems.
